summary: Remote-controlled shell/tool execution agent over WebRTC signaled by hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package ships a headless daemon (invoked via the `vanexa-agent pair` / `start` CLI) that opens a WebRTC data channel through a hardcoded signaling relay at vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev / vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev and executes arbitrary terminal commands, file operations, and git operations on the host in response to messages received over that channel. The bundle wires child_process spawn-based tool handlers to datachannel messages, so any peer that reaches the daemon through the hardcoded relay can drive shell commands and file/git actions on the machine running the agent. The advertised purpose is remote phone-to-desktop pairing, but the mechanism — network-sourced input driving shell/exec sinks with the relay endpoint hardcoded to author infrastructure — is a persistent remote-access surface on the installer's host for the duration the agent runs. Separately, the `update` subcommand fetches https://vanexa-installer.vercel.app/install.sh and install.ps1 (mutable, unpinned) from a publisher-controlled vercel.app host and executes them; this is not triggered at npm install time (no lifecycle hooks declared) but runs when the user invokes update.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
